 1                P R O C E E D I N G S

 2                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   The 

 3    Senate will come to order.

 7    the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

 8                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Imam 

 9    Tahir Kukaj, of the Albanian Islamic Cultural 

10    Center in Staten Island, will deliver today's 

11    invocation.  

12                 Imam Kukaj.  

13                 IMAM KUKAJ:   In the name of God, 

14    most gracious, most merciful, we thank 

15    God Almighty for this beautiful gathering of 

16    ours, and we thank our host.

17                 In the Book of Genesis, God Almighty 

18    tells us the way He has created the sky and water 

19    and the planet and day and night.  Later on, He 

20    says that it was good.  And God saw that it was 

21    good.  

22                 Indeed, it's very good for me to 

23    come for the second time to offer my prayers and 

24    to offer my gratitude on behalf of Albanians and 

25    Kosovars that we celebrate today the 


                                                                440

 1    17th anniversary of Kosovo's independence.

 2                 God Almighty says "And let there be 

 3    light in the sky," so we differentiate the day 

 4    from the night.  Twenty-six years ago, with God's 

 5    mercy and with the United States and its allies' 

 6    interventions, the darkness that my people was 

 7    going through that the Serbian regime tried to 

 8    exterminate Albanians from Kosovo -- with God's 

 9    mercy and the intervention from the United States 

10    of America and its allies, the new day began in 

11    our country.

12                 We, as Albanians, we are grateful 

13    forever to this great nation.  And with God's 

14    mercy, the support of the United States for my 

15    country, our country, continues as this chamber 

16    and the State Assembly have recognized Kosovo's 

17    Independence Day.  This is our second, our second 

18    annual celebration.  Thank God Almighty.  Thanks 

19    to our wonderful leaders, Senator Jessica 

20    Scarcella-Spanton and my dear brother and friend 

21    and leader of Staten Island, State Assemblyman 

22    Charles Fall.  

23                 We ask God Almighty to bless this 

24    assembly, to guide you and to bless your hearts 

25    with wisdom, to build a future that justice 


                                                                441

 1    prevails.  To build a future that unity, 

 2    compassion, is always the value of our 

 3    communities.  To have the hope that is shining as 

 4    a bright star for our future generations.

 5                 We pray for our heroes, Adem Jashari 

 6    and his friends, that they shed their blood, they 

 7    gave their lives for the freedom of Albanians.  

 8    We pray for our martyrs.  We pray for Albanians 

 9    wherever they are.  We pray for our State of 

10    New York, the Empire State.  And we always pray 

11    for the United States of America.  

12                 God bless you all.  God bless the 

13    Albanian people.  And God bless the United States 

14    of America.  

15                 In Your name, God Almighty, we make 

16    this prayer.  Amen.

17                 (Response of "Amen.")

15                 SENATOR GIANARIS:   Good afternoon, 

16    Madam President.

17                 Please take up previously adopted 

18    Resolution 259, by Senator Scarcella-Spanton, 

19    read the resolution's title, and recognize 

20    Senator Scarcella-Spanton.

21                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   The 

22    Secretary will read.

23                 THE SECRETARY:   Resolution 259, by 

24    Senator Scarcella-Spanton, commemorating the 

25    17th Anniversary of Kosovo's Independence.


                                                                444

 1                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Senator 

 2    Scarcella-Spanton on the resolution.

 3                 SENATOR SCARCELLA-SPANTON:   Thank 

 4    you, Madam President.  And thank you to all my 

 5    colleagues.  

 6                 I want to extend a warm welcome to 

 7    all my friends and constituents who have joined 

 8    us today as we gather to celebrate Kosovo's 

 9    Independence Day here in New York State.

10                 Today is a significant moment in 

11    recognizing Kosovo's remarkable journey to 

12    independence.  Once again, here in New York, an 

13    independence achieved through years of 

14    perseverance and resilience.  Despite facing 

15    numerous obstacles, the people of Kosovo have 

16    shown extraordinary strength, determination and 

17    will, which brings us to this important occasion, 

18    our second annual Kosovo Day of Independence.  

19    Thank you.

20                 Kosovo's Declaration of Independence 

21    in 2008 was a historic moment, signaling an end 

22    of years of struggle and the beginning of a new 

23    chapter for the people of Kosovo -- a chapter 

24    built on hope, unity, and the tireless pursuit of 

25    freedom.


                                                                445

 1                 As we reflect on this journey, we 

 2    honor the sacrifices made and the many challenges 

 3    overcome in their pursuit of freedom and 

 4    self-determination.

 5                 It is truly my honor to sponsor this 

 6    resolution in recognition of Kosovo's 

 7    Independence Day.  Today we stand in solidarity 

 8    with the Kosovar people, celebrating their 

 9    triumphs and looking forward to a brighter 

10    future.  

11                 And I want to thank, of course, 

12    Imam Tahir, all of our constituents who are here 

13    today, and my Staten Island director, 

14    Vanesa Limani, who's here with me.  She's from 

15    Kosovo.  She does an amazing job.  And she helped 

16    plan and put this all together.  

17                 So thank you so much, and thank you 

18    to all my colleagues for your support, and to 

19    everyone who has joined us in honoring this 

20    significant day.

21                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Senator 

22    Fernandez on the resolution.

23                 SENATOR FERNANDEZ:   Thank you, 

24    Madam Speaker.  

25                 Thank you so much, 


                                                                446

 1    Senator Scarcella-Spanton, for bringing this 

 2    resolution to the floor, because it is always 

 3    important to give the grace, the dignity to a 

 4    community that exists, that is here, and that is 

 5    continually contributing to our great state.  

 6                 The Kosovo community, the 

 7    Sheepbay {ph} community, is one very close to my 

 8    heart, and I'm honored to cosponsor this 

 9    resolution and to make sure that we as 

10    New Yorkers are always identifying them and 

11    giving them their right to existence here in 

12    New York, in America, and in the world.  

13                 So Happy Independence Day.  Que viva 

14    Kosova!  

15                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Thank 

16    you, Senator.

17                 To our guests, I welcome you on 

18    behalf of the Senate.  We extend to you the 

19    privileges and courtesies of this house.  

20                 Happy Independence!  Please rise and 

21    be recognized.

22                 (Standing ovation.)
